spellbook.finance/limitations: workspaceId validates caller ownership only. A tracked store promotion belongs to the connected eBay account and can affect eligible listings across all of the caller's workspaces.
This is the tracked SpellBook promotion row and provider status, not checkout verification. Read it before replacing or disabling a promotion.

description: Read the caller's tracked eBay order-discount promotion, including store or lot scope, quantity threshold, percentage, status and dates. workspaceId is checked for owner access; the promotion belongs to the caller's connected eBay account.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.
